description:
Read a sample of real documents from a Firestore path and infer a FireCMS collection schema from them, without saving anything. Works for any path, subcollections included.

Inference is structural only: it derives data types, enum candidates and validation from the sampled values. The result is a complete collection schema that can be edited and saved as it is.

sampleSize.description: How many documents to sample (default 30, max 200). More samples give better enum and optionality detection.

name: preview_inferred_schema
title: Preview inferred schema
